title: ID0465633-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T5314324565001] CCS cannot be removed
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: Customer complains that they have sometimes that the plug from the CCS cable cannot be removed from the EV, the last time this happened was at 28.11.2025 11:17 swiss time.
Solution: According to IEC_61851-23_2014 the EV is the one that locks the mechanism -> EV related issue

additional_info.subject: ID0465633-DC/Si-D/CH-[Y2/T5314324565001] CCS cable issue CRM:02681001170
additional_info.body:
Hi Alex, good morning.
As per the norm IEC_61851-23_2014:
So it's clear that the EV is in the wrong here. We do not have any direct impact on the locking system, we only check if the locking is done correctly in CableCheck and if it's not then we don't go forward, that's the only check we do of the locking.
From there onwards, it's completely up to the EV to unlock when it should.
I hope this was what you needed and you can share with the customer.
I will close this ticket since it's related to the EV. If you need any help dealing with the aftermath do not hesitate to reach out to me directly, you can reply to this ticket and just include me in the recipients, this way it helps me remember.
Thanks and have a lovely vacation, merry Xmas and happy New Year if we don't talk until then :D
Best regards,
Francisco
